title: gitlab storage vars
description: gitlab storage vars that can be set

GITLAB_VERSION.description: Specific version of gitlab to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

GITLAB_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install GITLAB. 'libscript-native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise' or 'asdf' defers to third-party tools.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

GITLAB_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for GITLAB to listen on

GITLAB_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for GITLAB to listen on

GITLAB_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for GITLAB to listen on
